The '''''Griffon{{'s}}
 Wings''''' was a modified [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] that was used as a [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A short time after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the ''Griffon{{'s}} Wings'' flew to the [[Yorgraxx system/Legends|Yorgraxx system]] to scout out the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yorgraxx]], but after arriving in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], it was attacked by three [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Guardian-class light cruiser|''Guardian''-class light cruisers]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the planet. Fire from the Imperial ships damaged the transport and disabled its [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], forcing the crew to crash-land on Yorgraxx. The crash knocked out the vessel's crew and caused further damage to the vessel itself, but overall, the starship remained relatively intact. The two survivors of the ''[[Predator's Beak]]'', an Imperial [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]] that had crashed on the world a short time earlier, observed the descent of the ''Griffon's Wings'' and they set out to investigate the crashed transport.
